title: Understanding Gradient Descent
text: Gradient descent is an iterative optimization algorithm used to find the minimum of a function. It updates parameters in the opposite direction of the gradient of the function with respect to the parameters.

title: Convergence of Gradient Descent
text: Convergence in gradient descent depends on several factors, including the learning rate and the nature of the function being minimized. Consider how these factors might affect reaching a local minimum.

hintAnswer: The learning rate determines the size of the steps taken towards the minimum. If it's too large, it might overshoot the minimum; if too small, convergence might be slow.
title: Exploring Learning Rate
text: What role does the learning rate play in the convergence of gradient descent?
choices: It determines the size of the steps
It ensures convergence to the global minimum
It has no effect on convergence
It only affects the speed of convergence
